# Python XDK (`xdk` v0.11.2)

> Official Python client library for the X API v2 (Python 3.8+). Install with `pip install xdk`.

## Guides

- [Python overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/overview.md): Overview and quick example
- [Python install](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/install.md): Installation and requirements
- [Python quickstart](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/quickstart.md): Make your first X API v2 request
- [Python authentication](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/authentication.md): Bearer Token, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and OAuth 1.0a
- [Python pagination](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/pagination.md): Cursor pagination across multi-page endpoints
- [Python streaming](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/streaming.md): Real-time event streams and filtered stream rules

## Client Reference

- [Reference Overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/overview.md): Client options and client list
- [`AccountClient` (Account)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/account.md): 2 methods via `client.account`
- [`AccountActivityClient` (Account Activity)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/account-activity.md): 5 methods via `client.account_activity`
- [`ActivityClient` (Activity)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/activity.md): 5 methods via `client.activity`
- [`ArticlesClient` (Articles)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/articles.md): 2 methods via `client.articles`
- [`BotsClient` (Bots)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/bots.md): 6 methods via `client.bots`
- [`BroadcastsClient` (Broadcasts)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/broadcasts.md): 41 methods via `client.broadcasts`
- [`CallsClient` (Calls)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/calls.md): 10 methods via `client.calls`
- [`ChatClient` (Chat)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/chat.md): 45 methods via `client.chat`
- [`CommunitiesClient` (Communities)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/communities.md): 2 methods via `client.communities`
- [`CommunityNotesClient` (Community Notes)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/community-notes.md): 5 methods via `client.community_notes`
- [`ComplianceClient` (Compliance)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/compliance.md): 6 methods via `client.compliance`
- [`ConnectionsClient` (Connections)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/connections.md): 4 methods via `client.connections`
- [`DirectMessagesClient` (Direct Messages)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/direct-messages.md): 9 methods via `client.direct_messages`
- [`GeneralClient` (General)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/general.md): 1 methods via `client.general`
- [`ListsClient` (Lists)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/lists.md): 9 methods via `client.lists`
- [`MediaClient` (Media)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/media.md): 19 methods via `client.media`
- [`NewsClient` (News)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/news.md): 2 methods via `client.news`
- [`PostsClient` (Posts)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/posts.md): 17 methods via `client.posts`

- [`UsersClient` (Users)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/python/reference/clients/users.md): 46 methods via `client.users`
